draft.subject: Notes that hold up when the payer asks
draft.body:
Amara,

Most denials happen weeks after the session. The payer pulls the note, finds a mismatch between the code and the documentation, and sends it back.

JotPsych scans every note against 150+ payer rules before you submit the claim. It flags the gaps — missing time, vague language, code misalignment — while you can still fix them.

The note either supports the code or it doesn't. This just tells you which before the payer does.

Works with any EHR. Or replaces it entirely. No migration required — up in 5 minutes.

Worth another look?

Best,

[Name]
JotPsych

--
